content.recommendation: Low-dose colchicine (0.5 mg once daily) may be considered, particularly if other risk factors are insufficiently controlled or if recurrent cardiovascular disease events occur under optimal therapy.
content.context: Recommendations for long-term management (anti-inflammatory drugs) from ESC 2023 guideline excerpt.
footnotes_summary: Increase statin potency/dose if patient was on low-potency/low-dose statin; add ezetimibe if patient was only on statins at highest tolerated dose, or add PCSK9 inhibitor if patient was on statins plus ezetimibe.
Angiotensin receptor blockers as option in cases of intolerance.

Associated Conditions: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease / recurrent cardiovascular events
genes.context: Listed in abbreviation glossary as 'PCSK9, proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9' and referenced in footnote advising 'add PCSK9 inhibitor if the patient was on statins plus ezetimibe.'
